body:
Real milestone while you sleep: the live run just completed Phase 3B across ALL 9 regimes. That has never happened before in this project's recorded history -- every prior attempt (3 in the ratchet log, one more yesterday) either never got there or truncated partway through. This one finished all 9 in under 40 minutes.

Two real findings came out of it, not manufactured:

1. Its own synthesis line: 8/9 regimes powered, and most of them show real, measured non-stationary structure -- sign flips or strong time-variation -- which is a direct live confirmation of the "edges flip sign, don't average across them" idea your document is built around. Not a test case. A live measurement from tonight's actual run.

2. A confluence-detection check (forge-organism) fired and honestly reported "not confirmed this run" -- two different scoring approaches agreed on which bars qualify, so the enhanced version isn't adding anything distinguishable yet, at least on this sample.

Still running -- it's gone quiet for a few minutes, which just means it's computing the next phase, not stuck (the watcher would have told me if the process died). Still not touching the source. Will keep you posted.
